messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty auto-page fired: SEV2 — edge-router error-rate spike. Metric: edge-5xx-rate (60s) = 12.1% (threshold 5%). Region: us-west-2. Alert link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/alerts/edge-5xx

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident #INC-34921 created and routed to oncall. Ack required.

Alex G: acked on PD, I'm on it. quick sanity checks first — is this traffic pattern global or single route?

Priya S: I see 5xx concentrated on route: /v1/infer -> edge-router pool A (weight 60%). EU/asia low.

Samir K: logs show spike started at 1713456680 (~1.5m ago). Top upstream errors are 502 from kvcache sidecar and 504 from model-proxy.

Maya R: attaching short log snip from edge: ```
[2024-04-06T16:19:40Z] 10.12.4.9 GET /v1/infer 502 upstream=model-proxy-23 status=502 latency=120ms
[2024-04-06T16:19:41Z] 10.12.4.11 GET /v1/infer 504 upstream=model-proxy-12 status=504 latency=30s
```

Alex G: rolling mitigation plan: 1) reduce weight on pool A to 20% (route fallback to pool B), 2) enable retry-to-frontend with linear backoff, 3) watch error rate for 5m, escalate if no improvement.

Priya S: agree. will push traffic shift now. command I will run: ```sh
# set route weight to fallback
redwoodctl routing set-weight --route /v1/infer --pool pool-A --weight 0.2 --pool pool-B --weight 0.8 --reason "auto mitigation: high 5xx"
```

Samir K: copying runbook entry: Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.local/runbooks/edge-5xx-fanout. If shifting doesn't help, fallback is to enable static proxy fallback and open PD with infra.

Priya S: executing... :hourglass:

deploy-bot: Command accepted by control-plane, change id changelist-6219 queued.

Priya S: change applied. route weights now pool-A=20%, pool-B=80%.

Alex G: monitoring... grafana shows 1m after change: error-rate dropped to 6.3% — good sign. Keep watch.

Samir K: checking customer impact — top 10 clients by request volume: none above 0.9% of traffic; error responses flagged for 3 customer keys: cust-phi, cust-ml, cust-beta. pinging SE for cust-phi.

Maya R: quick curl from edge: ```sh
curl -i -s "https://edge-api.usw2.redwood.ai/v1/infer" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TEST}" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
# earlier: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
# now: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

Alex G: nice. continue to watch for 10m window. if errors spike >7% again, we'll do full pool-A quarantine and open infra run (kube drain + recreate nodes behind model-proxy).

Priya S: alert suppression? PD auto-pages are noisy. we should set a short suppression for this alertchain while in mitigation. Thoughts @pagerduty

pagerduty: Applied 10m suppression window for paging while incident is active. Manual ack still required for followups.

Samir K: investigating root cause with runtime team — early hypothesis: model-proxy OOM under certain request fanout from pool-A due to increased kv-cache misses. Collecting pprof and pod logs.

Priya S: pprof saved to s3://redwood-logs/pprof/pprof-1713456789.pb.gz and uploaded.

Alex G: ok if we see regression after traffic normalization, we'll trigger canary rollback of last routing change (change-6201) that landed ~2h ago. For now, keep pool-A at 20%.

Maya R: notified support to watch customer queues and create tickets for cust-phi/cust-ml if they surface.

Samir K: extracted a histogram of response latencies: tail increased from 120ms to 8s coincident with 5xx spike. Pattern matches KV cache thrashing.

Alex G: set a temp circuit breaker on pool-A via: ```sh
redwoodctl routing set-circuit-breaker --pool pool-A --max-requests 50 --interval 60s
```

Priya S: circuit breaker set. Observability: error-rate now 3.2% after ~6m. latency tail improving.

Maya R: filing post-incident note draft, will include timeline and customer impact.

Alex G: folks — I'll take ownership until resolved. If stable for next 30m, we'll mark mitigated and schedule follow-up with runtime team for root cause. tagging next oncall Maya R for handoff at 17:10 UTC.

pagerduty: Incident marked Mitigated (error-rate under threshold). PD note: mitigation by traffic shift and circuit-breaker.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Action log: traffic-shift (changelist-6219), circuit-breaker (cb-331), pprof upload, suppression window. Closing timeline entry.

Priya S: leaving recollection: recommend increasing kv-cache size on pool-A and add quota-based admission to model-proxy. Will write RFC.

Maya R: ack — I will pick up the follow-up and schedule retro. handing off to Maya R now. :handshake:

Alex G: thanks team. good job fast mitigation. 

Maya R: acknowledged handoff. will follow up with incident doc and customer outreach notes.
